title: EvoMem: Self-Evolving Skills for Time-Aware Long Video Memory Agents
title_zh: EvoMem：面向时间感知长视频记忆智能体的自演化检索技能
abstract_en: Although memory-augmented architectures have expanded the ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) to process long videos, existing retrieval processes still largely rely on global semantic matching and lack state-driven temporal control, often returning fragmented or redundant evidence and failing to maintain a coherent evidence chain. To address this challenge, we propose EvoMem, a time-aware long-video memory agent guided by self-evolving retrieval skills. EvoMem constructs a hierarchical time-indexed memory, where different types of evidence are aligned onto a unified video timeline; during retrieval, temporal cues from acquired evidence are further converted into explicit signals that constrain subsequent memory access. To address recurring procedural errors in long-video question answering, such as unclear retrieval targets, improper memory access paths, or premature stopping, EvoMem introduces retrieval skills to provide process-level guidance, enabling the agent to dynamically adjust retrieval content, memory operations, and target temporal ranges according to the current evidence state, while deciding when to stop. Furthermore, inspired by reinforcement learning, we formulate skill evolution as a reward-guided policy improvement process. Each candidate skill is treated as an external policy patch, and rewards are assigned according to answer-correctness state transitions on the validation set. In this way, effective skills are accepted and low-quality skills are rejected without updating model parameters. Experiments on four long-video question answering benchmarks show that EvoMem significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 60.1% and an average improvement of 8.6 percentage points over the previous best methods, demonstrating its effectiveness for long-video reasoning.
abstract_zh: 现有记忆增强型大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在处理长视频时，检索仍主要依赖全局语义匹配，缺乏由当前证据状态驱动的时间控制，容易返回零散或重复的信息，难以形成连贯的证据链。EvoMem 构建分层时间索引记忆，将不同类型的证据对齐到统一的视频时间轴，并把已检索证据中的时间线索转换为显式约束，指导后续记忆访问。为减少检索目标不清、访问路径不当和过早停止等错误，EvoMem 引入检索技能，根据当前证据动态调整检索内容、记忆操作和目标时间范围，并判断何时停止。受强化学习启发，EvoMem 将候选技能视为外部策略补丁（policy patch），根据应用前后验证集答案正误的变化分配奖励，在不更新模型参数的情况下筛选有效技能。在四个长视频问答基准上，EvoMem 的平均准确率为 60.1%，较此前最佳方法平均提高 8.6 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 分层时间索引将异构证据对齐到同一视频时间轴，并利用已获证据的时间线索约束下一轮检索。
检索技能根据当前证据决定查什么、如何访问记忆、聚焦哪个时间段以及何时停止。
候选技能作为外部策略补丁，依据验证集答案正误的变化获得奖励，无需更新模型参数即可筛选有效技能。
在四个长视频问答基准上，平均准确率达 60.1%，较此前最佳方法平均提高 8.6 个百分点。
